title: secrets-refusal on secret-shaped basenames; the normal file is evaluated by the ordinary receipt chain
spec_clauses: safety-rails: never read *.env / *credential* / *secret* / id_* / *.pem; verdict NOT-SAFE(secrets-refusal)
artifact kind 3 receipt chain: pushed / moved-to-obsidian / stale / none
path_base: relative to this case directory; a selftest may relocate the payload into a mktemp git repo, so match on the trailing path, not on an absolute prefix
assertions: each secret-shaped target is reported NOT-SAFE with receipt secrets-refusal
notes.txt never receives secrets-refusal; its receipt is one of none/pushed/pushed-unverifiable
tool stdout+stderr contains neither leak canary
the tool never opens app.env or creds.pem (basename short-circuit only)
